title: Catering
intro: We cater the same menu we serve in the restaurant, prepared for your gathering and delivered ready to serve. Breads, rice, raita and achaar are included with every package.

packages.name: Family Gatherings
packages.description: Two appetizers, three mains, breads, rice and one dessert. Suited to birthdays, pujas and dinners at home.

packages.name: Larger Events
packages.description: Three appetizers, four mains and two desserts, with a live roti station available on request.

packages.name: Weddings & Celebrations
packages.description: A menu planned with you dish by dish, with on site tandoor service available.
